documents.notes: First-year 'How to apply' checklist. All first-year applicants self-report courses and grades through STARS (no vocabulary kind); a final official transcript is required if admitted. 'We ask that you not send letters of recommendation or other supplemental materials'; no interviews. The page states no academic year.

items.quote: You may apply to the UW using the Common App.
The Common App essay, often referred to as the personal essay, is a required and important part of your application.
International students must submit English proficiency test scores that meet the minimum requirement for admission.

If you have attended a school outside of the U.S. that follows a national compulsory curriculum, you are required to upload a scanned, unofficial copy of your transcript for grade levels 9 and higher as part of your Common App application.
items.condition: the applicant attended a school outside the U.S. that follows a national compulsory curriculum

items.quote: Records from schools outside the U.S. must be in English or in the native language and accompanied by official English translations.
items.condition: records from schools outside the U.S. are not in English

items.quote: Homeschooled applicants and applicants who come from schools with non-standard grading practices that do not have letter or numeric grades are still required to submit SAT or ACT scores.
items.condition: homeschooled, or from a school with non-standard grading (no letter or numeric grades)
